info.name: Lists the SQL Tuning Advisor tasks.

params.name: managedDatabaseId
params.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Managed Database.

params.name: name
params.description: The optional query parameter to filter the SQL Tuning Advisor task list by name.

params.name: status
params.description: The optional query parameter to filter the SQL Tuning Advisor task list by status.

params.name: timeGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The optional greater than or equal to query parameter to filter the timestamp.

params.name: timeLessThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The optional less than or equal to query parameter to filter the timestamp.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page token representing the page from where the next set of paginated results
are retrieved. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned in the paginated response.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The option to sort the SQL Tuning Advisor task summary data.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The option to sort information in ascending (‘ASC’) or descending (‘DESC’) order. Descending order is the default order.

info.name: Retrieve a comparison of the existing SQL execution plan and new plan.

params.name: managedDatabaseId
params.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Managed Database.

params.name: sqlTuningAdvisorTaskId
params.description: The SQL tuning task identifier. This is not the [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: sqlObjectId
params.description: The SQL object ID for the SQL tuning task. This is not the [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: executionId
params.description: The execution ID for an execution of a SQL tuning task. This is not the [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

items.docs:
Retrieves a comparison of the existing SQL execution plan and a new plan.
A SQL tuning task may suggest a new execution plan for a SQL,
and this API retrieves the comparison report of the statistics of the two plans.

info.name: Gets an array of details for the findings that match the given filters.

params.name: managedDatabaseId
params.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Managed Database.

params.name: sqlTuningAdvisorTaskId
params.description: The SQL tuning task identifier. This is not the [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: beginExecId
params.description: The optional greater than or equal to filter on the execution ID related to a specific SQL Tuning Advisor task.

params.name: endExecId
params.description: The optional less than or equal to query parameter to filter on the execution ID related to a specific SQL Tuning Advisor task.

params.name: searchPeriod
params.description:
The search period during which the API will search for begin and end exec id, if not supplied.
Unused if beginExecId and endExecId optional query params are both supplied.

params.name: findingFilter
params.description: The filter used to display specific findings in the report.

params.name: statsHashFilter
params.description: The hash value of the object for the statistic finding search.

params.name: indexHashFilter
params.description: The hash value of the index table name.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The possible sortBy values of an object's recommendations.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The option to sort information in ascending (‘ASC’) or descending (‘DESC’) order. Descending order is the default order.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page token representing the page from where the next set of paginated results
are retrieved. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of records returned in the paginated response.

items.docs: Gets an array of the details of the findings that match specific filters.

params.name: managedDatabaseId
params.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Managed Database.

params.name: sqlTuningAdvisorTaskId
params.description: The SQL tuning task identifier. This is not the [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: searchPeriod
params.description: How far back the API will search for begin and end exec id. Unused if neither exec ids nor time filter query params are supplied. This is applicable only for Auto SQL Tuning tasks.

params.name: beginExecIdGreaterThanOrEqualTo

params.name: endExecIdLessThanOrEqualTo
params.description: The optional less than or equal to query parameter to filter on the execution ID related to a specific SQL Tuning Advisor task. This is applicable only for Auto SQL Tuning tasks.
